title: The Cloud-Native Journey
excerpt: This article walks through all twelve factors of the Twelve-Factor App methodology — codebase management, dependency isolation, config, backing services, build/release/run separation, statelessness, port binding, horizontal scaling, fast startup, dev/prod parity, log streams, and admin processes — and explains why each one still matters. It closes with a practical, stage-by-stage view of what a cloud-native journey looks like in practice: codifying everything, containerizing with discipline, externalizing state, orchestrating with Kubernetes, automating the pipeline, and treating observability as a first-class concern.
